title: Algorithmic trading and stochastic integration
abstract: arXiv:2609.31578v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study simple predictable processes whose coefficients are represented by neural networks. On finite measure spaces, we establish density results for neural networks in Orlicz spaces. For filtrations generated by a stochastic process, measurable random variables, including at stopping times, can be approximated by neural networks depending on finitely many observations. Every stochastic integral with respect to a semimartingale can then be approximated, in the semimartingale topology, by integrals of such simple predictable processes. We show that restricting trading strategies to this class leaves the minimal mean-variance hedging error under partial information unchanged and obtain a no-free-lunch characterization in terms of equivalent martingale measures. Finally, the Bichteler-Dellacherie characterization of semimartingales remains valid even upon restricting the predictable integrands to those whose coefficients are represented

translated_abstract: 我们研究系数由神经网络表示的简单可料过程。在有限测度空间上，我们建立了神经网络在Orlicz空间中的稠密性结果。对于由随机过程生成的域流，可测随机变量（包括在停时处的随机变量）可以由仅依赖有限多次观测的神经网络来逼近。由此，每一个关于半鞅的随机积分都可以在半鞅拓扑下由这类简单可料过程的积分来逼近。我们证明，将交易策略限制在这一类中不会改变部分信息下的最小均值-方差对冲误差，并得到了以等价鞅测度刻画的“无免费午餐”特征。最后，即使将可料被积函数限制为那些系数由神经网络表示的函数，半鞅的Bichteler-Dellacherie刻画仍然成立。
tldr: 该论文证明以神经网络为系数的简单可料过程在半鞅拓扑下可逼近任意随机积分，因此将交易策略限制为神经网络策略不会改变最小均值-方差对冲误差，且无套利刻画与半鞅的Bichteler-Dellacherie特征依然成立。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that simple predictable processes with neural-network coefficients are dense in stochastic integrals under the semimartingale topology, so restricting trading strategies to neural-network-based ones preserves minimal mean-variance hedging errors, no-free-lunch characterizations, and the Bichteler-Dellacherie characterization of semimartingales.
